# Unavailable-cell regression input

A real Nsight 2026.3.1.0/build 38722833 regime subset preserving duplicate
headers, numeric text and literal nan cells. Qualified parsing returns null for
those cells; finite-only policies reject them. Other nonfinite spellings and
nonfinite timing/frame values remain errors. provenance.json describes extraction;
the input does not establish a cause for missing hardware measurements.
